entities.name: 2-nitro-6-(difluoromethoxy)pyridine
observations: Decoded reactant is O=[N+]([O-])c1ncccc1OC(F)F, an aromatic nitro pyridine bearing a difluoromethoxy substituent.

entities.name: 2-amino-6-(difluoromethoxy)pyridine
observations: Decoded product is the corresponding amino pyridine, formed by reduction of the aromatic nitro group.

entities.name: Nitro pyridine reduction
observations: The net transformation is aromatic nitro-group reduction, Ar-NO2 to Ar-NH2, with the difluoromethoxy substituent retained.

entities.name: Acetic acid ethanol 100 C
observations: ORD record ord-322186024cd94b3ea25032e9cba6b484 reports acetic acid/ethanol at 100 °C for 8 hours and 66% yield for a close nitro-to-amino precedent.

entities.name: Iron ammonium chloride ethanol water
observations: ORD record ord-263cdbda7c8d449caa422a16b3975338 reports Fe and NH4Cl in ethanol/water at 90 °C and 55% yield for a close nitro-to-amino precedent.
